name: Ordaōs
headline: Source-grounded AI search and 12 production workflows for a protein design biotech
overview: Ordaōs is a New York biotech that designs therapeutic proteins with generative AI. Techlio built the AI layer around that science: Python automation, retrieval-augmented generation over its research knowledge, and end-to-end AI workflows connecting data, analysis and reporting.

metrics.label: less manual data and reporting work

challenges.title: Knowledge spread across sources
challenges.text: Papers, assay results, design runs and partner documents lived in separate systems, so finding context for a target meant hours of searching.

challenges.title: Manual, repetitive workflows
challenges.text: Scientists and operations staff moved data between tools and compiled reports by hand.

challenges.title: Accuracy in a scientific domain
challenges.text: Generic AI tools hallucinate and cannot cite sources, which is unacceptable when answers inform therapeutic design.

challenges.title: Scaling with partner programs
challenges.text: Each new partnership added data and reporting load that a small team had to absorb without new headcount.

solutions.title: RAG knowledge assistant
solutions.text: A retrieval system over research and program documents that answers in plain language with citations back to the source.

solutions.title: Python data and automation pipelines
solutions.text: Services that ingest, clean and structure scientific and operational data so it flows downstream without manual handling.

solutions.title: AI automation flows
solutions.text: LLM-powered flows for recurring tasks such as summarizing results, drafting program updates and routing information.

solutions.title: End-to-end workflows with guardrails
solutions.text: Ingestion, retrieval, generation and human review connected with logging, so every output is traceable and reviewable.

results: 12 end-to-end AI workflows live in production
250,000 research and program documents searchable through RAG
45% less manual data and reporting work, about 18 hours saved per employee each week
Cited, source-grounded answers for scientific and partner questions
architecture: Python services ingest and prepare research documents. pgvector stores their embeddings in PostgreSQL beside the relational data, LangChain orchestrates retrieval, and Claude writes answers that cite their sources. n8n runs the operational workflows, and everything is deployed on AWS.
